pages.title: Exotic Summon Arts
pages.text: Magicites are ancient eldritch catalysts awakened through nuclear-harmonic transmutation.$(br2)Each summon requires $(6)10,000 FE$(0) stored in its internal buffer and a 15-second cooldown.$(br2)They are bound in the $(5)Transmutation Cube$(0) by fusing a $(e)Nether Star$(0) with $(5)Overdrive Powder$(0) and an elemental catalyst.

pages.title: Praxis: Absolute 0
pages.text: Catalyst: $(b)Blue Ice$(0).$(br2)Freezes ambient atmosphere into spinning ice monoliths and crystalline shrapnel, unleashing repeated 40-damage frost pulses within a 12-block radius.

pages.title: Veritas: Purifier
pages.text: Catalyst: $(d)Amethyst Cluster$(0).$(br2)Unleashes a cascade of blinding golden-white celestial radiance, incinerating hostile entities with purifying light pulses.

pages.title: Paradox: Not RAEL
pages.text: Catalyst: $(5)Eye of Ender$(0).$(br2)Rips a chromatic glitch in local space-time. Entities caught inside suffer extreme reality shear and gravitational distortion.

pages.title: Aequitas: Full Measure
pages.text: Catalyst: $(3)Soul Campfire$(0).$(br2)Channels a devastating soul thunder storm triad, striking the earth with bolts of azure lightning and roaring soul flame vortexes.
